notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least three cards this turn.
description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Heliod. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
